title: BBQ sauce
preamble:
1/2 cup weakly prepared yellow mustard - 2 heaped teaspoons mustard

1/2 cup apple cider vinegar vinegar

1/2 cup brown sugar

1 tablespoon honey

1 heaped teaspoon chopped oregano
ingredients: 1/2 cup weakly prepared yellow mustard - 2 heaped teaspoons mustard
method: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and simmer for 30 minutes.
Allow to cool, place in an airtight container, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours to blend the flavors.
